items.title: Normal injected-profile teardown still calls `testutil
items.body: Normal injected-profile teardown still calls `testutil.RemoveDataDir`, which invokes host `os.RemoveAll`. Task2 now creates these datanode directories through `environmentFS`, newly exposing this existing callback as a host-I/O escape. `TestCluster_InjectedProfile` follows this path during cleanup. Coincident host paths can also be deleted.
items.suggestion: Use `removeEnvironmentData(z.exec, args.DataDir)` for datanode cleanup, as the walkanode paths already do.

items.title: Single-zone profiles leak the TCP gossip listener and its accept goroutine
items.body: Single-zone profiles leak the TCP gossip listener and its accept goroutine. `NewTCPPeer` starts the transport, but `NewWalkaboutNode` creates memberlist only when there are multiple zones (`walker/walkabout/server/walkabout_node.go:209`). Walkabout shutdown therefore never closes this transport, and successful node cleanup has no independent transport shutdown. Restarting the single-zone configuration used by `TestCluster_InjectedProfile` fails when `LocalNode.StartNoWait` rebinds the still-open gossip port.
items.suggestion: Give the in-process node explicit ownership of the transport and close it on termination, including when memberlist was never created. Verify single-zone stop/restart and listener rebinding.

items.title: Startup-error cleanup breaks the existing native port-conflict retry
items.body: Startup-error cleanup breaks the existing native port-conflict retry. In a multi-zone native cluster, memberlist can return an `"address already in use"` error while binding its independently selected UDP port. The new defer closes the main and bimmer listeners, but `LocalNode.StartNoWait` retries with those same listener objects (`walker/localcluster/node.go:511–524`). Even if the next membership bind succeeds, gRPC receives closed listeners and startup fails.
items.suggestion: Recreate the consumed listeners before retrying, preserving the required addresses, or retain them across retryable failures while cleaning up terminal failures.

items.title: Profile bimmers share mutable `EngineOptions`
items.body: Profile bimmers share mutable `EngineOptions`. `VolumeOptions.Clone` is shallow, so every bimmer registry retains the same profile engine-options pointer. With default options, `EngineOptions.Clock` starts nil; unchanged `VolumeOptions.ensureDefaults` reads and assigns it during volume creation (`volume_options.go:61`). The cluster starts datanodes concurrently (`local_cluster.go:430`), allowing their bimmers to race on this field. Previously, each bimmer received fresh default options.
items.suggestion: Clone `EngineOptions` when producing each component’s volume options, as the profile’s initial clone already does.
